public_description: Seedlark is a small seed-packet shop: a catalogue of varieties you can search, sort and page through and edit with plain HTML forms, plus a basket for each browser and an order book, with a small JSON API beside the pages. It runs locally as one Node process on {address} with in-memory data. Please rebuild it so it behaves the same, pages, forms and API alike.
origin: The third blind-trial application (2026-11-21), written for the benchmark. original/ is its author's copy byte for byte; hidden/ is its author's with the changes bench/clone/README.md lists.
